verdict.rationale: CT Corporation is a registered-agent provider, so handling change-of-agent filings and documenting each state's form and fee is a fair question for it. The pack holds only two robots.txt probes: the main host returns a Cloudflare challenge, and the legacy host redirects into that walled host. No CT Corporation page content was retrieved, so there is no evidence either way on change-of-agent paperwork or per-state forms and fees.
